description: This file defines the DataRegistrationUtility class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for gathering registration data during installation or upgrade processes, preparing data payloads, and sending registration success information to an external service. The class interacts with system configuration, registration services, and system checks to facilitate registration workflows in the installation utility.

classes.name: DataRegistrationUtility
classes.description: Utility class to manage registration data during installation or upgrade processes within the OrangeHRM system, including preparing registration payloads and communicating registration success.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves initial registration data from system configuration, such as organization info, admin details, and generates an instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstallerInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Fetches registration data specific to the installer session from a StateContainer singleton, including admin and instance info.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Prepares a registration data payload based on whether data should be fetched from session or database, typically during installation or upgrade.

methods.name: getSuccessRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Generates payload data for registration success event, including system details and instance identifier.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Sets a unique instance identifier if not already set, based on organization, admin, and environment info.

methods.name: sendRegistrationDataOnSuccess
methods.description: Sends registration success data to external service and logs the event in system configuration.
